body:
Founder real-time: 'i want to reset training but not include certain models from the registry - can you add a checkbox to the registry backend to disable those models from the league?' New is_disabled column on brawlpit_rl_checkpoints (migration 202609131700), CheckpointStore.SetDisabled (a real, independent per-row flag, distinct from the single-global is_active_opponent), new admin-cookie-gated PATCH /admin/nock/api/brawlpit-checkpoints/:id/disable, new checkbox column in the NOCK AI Opponents table (frontend/nock/src/AiOpponents.tsx). Enforcement side built too: rl_train_packet.py's --resume-from-registry lookup and rl_bot_pool.py's fetch_pool_bots both now skip any is_disabled checkpoint, so the checkbox actually excludes a model from resumed training and the bot pool, not just the UI. 5 new Go tests + full existing suite pass; deployed live with a real pre-deploy DB+binary backup, confirmed via a live GET that the new field is present on production.

⚓ ☃
title: S428: real, reversible 'disable from league' checkbox for the checkpoint registry
